title: Readiness After a Choice-Word Run and Reset
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic finite-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $m$ be a nonnegative integer. If a configuration $a$ is ready at $m$, the input length is at most $m$, and a Boolean choice word $u$ has length exactly $m$, then the configuration obtained by running $A$ on $u$ from $a$ and applying the next-attempt reset is ready at $m$.
hypotheses_covered: The input length is at most $m$
The choice word $u$ has length exactly $m$
